answer: Rotating Witness Mirror. Each epoch, a verifiable random function selects a small witness panel from all identities; joiners must complete a challenge round witnessed only by that panel, and the panel’s composition stays hidden until after the round. The pool sits at a karst of unlinkable slots, so attackers cannot predict which identities will judge them, forcing broad infiltration. At the nadir of each cycle, every surviving identity costs fresh challenge work plus delay, paid per attempt across all sybils.
